photos.alt: The front of The Raddish Roost on a sunny day, a dark-shingled farmhouse with green trim, a covered porch, a white screen door, and hostas along the lawn.
The front of The Raddish Roost seen through evergreen trees, with the driveway along the side of the house.
Living room with a brown leather sofa and chairs, a wall-mounted television, crossed wooden skis, and a black wood stove.
A wide view of the living room opening toward the kitchen, with a leather sofa, a jute rug, and wide pine floors.
Brown leather sofa and chairs around a wood and glass coffee table, with windows, a wooden ladder, and a round wall clock.
A sitting area with brown leather chairs, snowshoes on the wall, white cabinets, and an antler chandelier.
Leather chairs and a live-edge coffee table, with the stairs visible down the hall.
Dining room with a wooden farm table, a bench, black chairs, a black chandelier, and a sign that reads Farmhouse.
Kitchen with sage green cabinets, a dark countertop, a sink and dishwasher, and a white refrigerator, looking through to the dining room.
Gas stove in the kitchen under a wooden sign that reads Raddish Roost, Waterbury, VT, with the dining room through the doorway.
Kitchen sink and dishwasher in a sage green island, with the laundry room doorway to the right.
Kitchen pass-through with two stools, the gas stove and refrigerator behind it, and the living room through the left doorway.
Laundry room with a stacked washer and dryer, a wood folding counter, and a laundry basket.
Bathroom with a tub and shower, a brown gingham curtain, wood-paneled walls, a toilet, and a wall-mounted sink.
Sitting area with the bathroom door open, showing the sink and wood-paneled walls inside.
Stairs seen from the upstairs landing, with a metal handrail and a Ski Lodge sign on the wall.
Bedroom under a sloped ceiling with a dark wood bed, a floral quilt, and a window with linen curtains.
Bedroom under a sloped ceiling with a bed in a navy quilt, a white nightstand, and a window with linen curtains.
Bedroom under a sloped ceiling with a striped coverlet, rolled blankets, a wood nightstand, and a patterned rug.
Close view of a live-edge wood coffee table with a book about vintage skiing.
Wood console table with a dark vase, wooden beads, a book, and a small wooden sculpture.
Wooden letter tiles on a board spelling Welcome to the Raddish Roost.
Aerial view of downtown Waterbury, with Main Street running between shops and a white church, and green mountains beyond.
Aerial view of Main Street in Waterbury looking toward the mountains, with houses, a church, and storefronts along the road.
A wider aerial view of Waterbury, with the town center, surrounding homes, and forested hills.
Aerial view of houses, lawns, and a green hillside beside a road in Waterbury.
The word Brewery painted in white on a brick wall, with arrows on either side and a basket of pink flowers.
